import(\"/private/var/folders/_x/wn2r0t5.description: Final or partial result produced by a tool.

content.description: Text or image content returned to the model.

details.description: Arbitrary structured details for logs or UI rendering.

structuredContent.description:
Machine-readable result matching the tool's `outputSchema`, for programmatic callers. Not sent
to the model; `content` remains the model-facing result.

usage.description: Usage from the final tool execution itself, if available. Not used for main LLM context accounting.

isError.description:
Report a failure without throwing. The model sees `content` as an error result, like a thrown
error, but `details` and `structuredContent` are kept for the UI and programmatic callers.

terminate.description:
Hint that the agent should stop after the current tool batch.
Early termination only happens when every finalized tool result in the batch sets this to true.

AgentToolResult.T.description: Tool producer assembles details; nested published records retain their own readonly contracts.

cacheWrite1h.description: Subset of `cacheWrite` written with 1h retention. Only Anthropic reports this split.

reasoning.description:
Reasoning/thinking tokens, when the provider reports them. This is a subset of
`output`: `output` already includes these tokens. Set to a number (possibly 0) by
providers that expose a reasoning breakdown; left undefined by providers that don't.
